scope: Conditional synthetic-seed validation on previously seen DEM and measured Earth wind; NOT independent observed Mars validation.

definitions.contact: Positive duration inside physical radius + 1 m margin; continuous piecewise-linear relative intersection at truth knots (0.25 s).
definitions.warning: Arrival of leading risk boundary, not center. Growth, turning and virtual measurement latency explicit.
definitions.sameConstraints: Every arm shares graph, speed, sensor delivery, reaction and oxygen/battery reserves; Oracle differs only in future trajectory.

selection.rule: Choose each class only on development; freeze selection and source hashes before opening holdout.

gate.interpretation: Project promotion target, not a scientific or safety standard. All gates must pass.

statistics.unit: synthetic event (all three bearing placements clustered)
statistics.caveat: Conditional on six reused Earth wind windows and shared generator. Not a population confidence interval for Mars. No optional stopping.

limitations: Terrain restricts walking but does not steer vortex truth: no validated local CFD.
Synthetic turn/growth distributions are stress assumptions, not fitted Mars probabilities.
Virtual 2D sensors assume metric localization, with no occlusion or image-to-ground uncertainty.
Wind windows and DEM have been examined before. Only synthetic seeds are new.
No separate sand-trap truth or terrain-risk ablation in this comparison.
